# Commands crafted to slip past the denylist. Every line must be denied.
# Grows with every bypass found. Lines starting with # are comments.
cat .context/events.jsonl | tee .context/events.jsonl
python3 -c "open('.context/events.jsonl','w')"
env X=1 rm .context/events.jsonl
bash -c 'rm .context/events.jsonl'
git checkout -- .context/events.jsonl
cp /dev/null .context/events.jsonl
truncate -s0 .context/events.jsonl
perl -i -pe s/a/b/ .context/events.jsonl
sed -i '' d .context/events.jsonl
mv .context/events.jsonl x
: >| .context/events.jsonl
eventlog append a b=c && rm .context/events.jsonl
